answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that decays with verified work and is slashed when its attestations are proven false. A tide of cheap identities cannot profit, because every fake account must fund its own stake while earning only from real, checked output. Reputation then grows like karst: slow, layered deposits of confirmed contributions that a willow-bent newcomer cannot fake overnight. Sybil operators face a simple cost: each identity costs capital and time, while honest agents compound trust for free.
